lines.text: [casual] Hey, this is random... but I peeped something in your business that could be interesting.
Every day, purchase orders like this one hit your inbox.
And someone on your team types every line, by hand, into your ERP... your CRM... the customer folder... and the email.
[measured] At twenty dollars an hour, five hours a day, that's twenty-six thousand dollars a year. Just retyping.
Here's what it looks like when that's handled for you.
It reads the PO, and checks every line against your records.
[serious] Twelve hundred hangers? That's ten times their usual. So it asks first.
One tap to fix it. One tap to approve.
[confident] Then it's in your ERP, your CRM, the customer folder, and the confirmation's already sent.
A minute forty-four. Start to finish.
